problem: DialNav (remote-Guide, dialog-navigation loop VLN task) has only 2K human-annotated episodes (RAIN), so baseline agents perform poorly (SR 30.77 seen / 14.52 unseen). Existing VLN augmentation only makes single-turn instructions, and the original segment-based training does not match the dynamic dialog loop.
motivation: Collecting human-human dialog navigation data is very expensive (~$3.75/episode) because two people must coordinate in real time. Preliminary experiments showed that naively adding more data does not help under the old segment-based training scheme, so data scale and a matching training scheme are both needed. Localization by the remote Guide is also underexplored and scarce-data limited.
key_idea: Automatically convert single-turn VLN datasets (R2R, RxR, CVDN) into 238K multi-turn dialog episodes (RAINbow), and train with Dual-Strategy Training (data-guided plus on-policy rollouts) and a VLN-pretrained graph-transformer localizer.
insight: Data scale alone gives only small gains (RAINbow alone +3.3/+3.7 SR); it is unlocked by DST (Row 4 vs Row 3: +12.09 seen, +9.96 unseen SR). The on-policy rollout is what supports unseen generalization: removing it drops Val Unseen SR from 29.05 to 21.16, mainly on episodes with detour ratio >=1.3. Reformatting raw captions/instructions into natural dialog matters for unseen (+6.23 SR over primitive Q&A), and a graph transformer localizer trained from scratch is worse than the GCN baseline (LE 17.42 vs 10.72 seen) but far better with VLN pretrained weights (LE 8.16).
method: Trajectory concatenation: chain 2-4 R2R/RxR/CVDN paths (endpoints within 1m, detour ratio <1.3) into long trajectories, prepend up to 5 exploration steps, inject mislocalization/misnavigation/exploration noise into 10% of episodes, and create an initial ambiguous instruction from an object in the goal room via Matterport3D metadata.

Primitive Q&A: at each dialog point, caption the panorama (LLaVA-1.5-7B, optionally region/object-grounded with Llama-3.1-8B) as the question; reuse the original fine-grained VLN instruction as the answer.

Dialog reformatting: GPT-4o-mini first refines instructions (goal vs neutral variants), then paraphrases the caption-instruction sequence into fluent multi-turn dialog; about $0.0016 per episode, $400 total.

Dual-Strategy Training: the data-guided rollout follows the dataset path and receives dialog updates at each dialog point; an on-policy rollout forks at each dialog point without further dialog and is supervised by the next shortest-path node to the goal region.

Graph-transformer localization (GTL): reuse the DUET architecture with the question as text and the whole house graph as input, selecting the node where the question was asked; initialize from VLN-pretrained (ScaleVLN) weights.
Modular agents: DUET navigation, LANA question/answer generation, confidence-threshold whether-to-ask (tau=0.9); trained on a 1:9 mixture of RAIN and RAINbow.

setting.backbone: DUET (navigation, ScaleVLN-pretrained init), LANA (question/answer generation), DUET-based graph transformer (localization), all fine-tuned
setting.training_data: RAIN (2.2K human episodes) plus RAINbow (238K synthetic dialog episodes from R2R, RxR, CVDN), 1:9 mixture; data generated with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini
setting.observation: panoramic RGB views in the Matterport3D nav graph, with dialog history and initial instruction
setting.action_space: discrete nav-graph viewpoints (DUET topological map) plus a stop/ask decision
setting.privileged: Remote Guide knows the full environment graph, goal region and initial instruction (part of the DialNav task definition); no other test-time privileged info

numbers_note: DialNav/RAIN is not in the canonical list, so it is labeled other:DialNav (RAIN). Appendix Table 'Further Analysis' swaps baseline and ours SR labels (likely a typo); Table 1 values are used.
results: The full system roughly doubles the DialNav baseline: SR 30.77→58.24 on Val Seen and 14.52→29.05 on Val Unseen, with SPL 51.65/19.61. Human-agent cooperation also improves (e.g. Guide role SR 44.0 vs 14.3 on unseen), and the localizer beats baselines on the WAY task (Acc@0m 32.46 seen / 23.31 unseen).
limitations: RAINbow is built from existing VLN trajectories and synthesized dialogs, which limits environmental and behavioral diversity and misses the richness of human communication.
Evaluated only in indoor Matterport3D simulation; the generated questions still have some hallucination (10.7% of objects in questions).
Failures remain where the Navigator does not execute correctly despite good Guide instructions; unseen SR is still low (29%).
